interest: Index on 1931 Japanese copper exports to Russia.
overview: Telegram (1932): Japan's 1931 copper industry stayed profitable via precious-metal byproducts despite low prices, exporting bars mainly to Russia.

people.name: Edwin L. Neville
people.role: U.S. Chargé d'Affaires ad interim in Tokyo

subfiles.about: Report on Japanese copper production, trade, major mining producers, and domestic market conditions in 1931.
subfiles.summary: Neville reports Japan's 1931 copper industry produced 74,800 tons, exported mainly to Russia, staying profitable via gold-silver byproducts.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Neville (Tokyo) on Japanese Copper Industry
